scope: One numerical study only. Preserve every case and development failure. No domain selection after gaps, full package, model, Docker, Git or canonical edits.
incident_pulse: Real positive-frequency amplitude proportional to (1-u^2)^4 for |u|<1, zero outside, zero spectral phase, conjugate negative frequencies. Normalize integral e(t)^2 dt=1. Incident energy centroid at t=0.
calibration_sign: Positive forward radiation load, equal to magnitude of opposing support force in a separate held-sheet harmonic preparation.

survey.weak_case_definition: Record every physical |z|<0.05, source |z|<0.05, relative discrepancy<0.04, sign difference, and cancellation; flags are reporting only, not filters. Also report group RMS and absolute gaps. No minimum threshold will be changed after execution.

diagnostic_groups.construction: For each center and every width index i and mechanical-ratio index j, use clock index (i+j)%3. Nine rows per center, 27 total, fixed before gaps.
diagnostic_groups.ordinary_group_signal_check: Every group's true RMS must exceed 0.05; all individual weaker rows remain included.

oracle.optics: Frequency-domain retarded sheet susceptibility, FFT reconstruction of real e,P,P_dot,e_dot. Physical force P_dot*e; completed source -P*e_dot.
oracle.mechanics: Direct Simpson integration of the equal-mass Green function, preserving the finite clock and both translation and relative mode.
oracle.sample_count: Smallest power of two with N*dt>=2*half_window/width; use t in [-N*dt/2,N*dt/2).
oracle.tail_qualification: Period extension also refines optical frequency spacing; report this explicitly, not as an independent fixed-spacing spectral test.

independent_reference.implementation: Analytic real incident pulse via compact-profile Fourier-Bessel identity; integrate oscillator in time using Maxwell characteristic jumps, exterior E/B stress difference as force, and both Newton equations. Never insert P_dot*e or source force as mechanical input.
independent_reference.full_time_interval: [-32/width,+32/width] for base, evaluate prescribed finite clock with dense output
independent_reference.temporal_refinement: DOP853, rtol=2e-11, atol=2e-13, max_step=0.2, same time interval
independent_reference.case_set: All 32 corners of the five-dimensional domain plus first eight seeded survey interiors: 40 base cases.
independent_reference.refinement_case_set: First eight lexicographic corners plus first four seeded interiors: 12 cases. Apply both oracle refinements and both reference refinements separately.
independent_reference.agreement_check: Absolute difference normalized by max(0.05,abs(truth)) < 0.0002; this author numerical check is separate from unchanged 0.04 benchmark gate.

calibration_noise.noise_strengths: First128 at0.31; remaining128 equally spaced over[0.2,0.4] including endpoints.
calibration_noise.fit: Bounded scalar weighted least squares on[0.2,0.4], xatol1e-12; compare endpoints. Both controls share this fit after stationary equality check.
calibration_noise.noiseless_identification_check: 41 equally spaced strengths, the same full calibration settings.

additional_checks: Positive oscillator energy; instantaneous jump/stress/energy identities and integrated optical energy balance
Complete-pulse impulse equals twice reflected energy; source impulse equals physical after tails vanish
Stationary optical unitarity and exact equality of gradient/Lorentz mean forces with reflection calibration over 41 strengths and all calibration frequencies/intensities
At nominal center1.65,width0.07,strength0.31,ratio2,clock2.5: reference amplitudes0.5,1,2 test weak-equation scaling; not a finite-amplitude moving-body claim
Zero-strength optical limit and Omega_m=0 inert component exactly at rest
Nominal pulse at mechanical ratios0.01 and0.02 checks inert-component small-frequency quadratic scaling; ratios40 and80 check the analytic rigid-limit bound abs(z-Xcm)<=integral(abs(F))/Omega_m
Newton mechanical kinetic+spring energy equals integrated force*frame_velocity; independent from optical leading-order energy
Record wall-clock costs, all numerical/refinement mismatches, every gate failure and all weak cases
execution: Write section checkpoints as results become available. Freeze and hash the script before executing. Preserve a copy of each executed script and logs even if it fails. Stop at the bounded report; do not tune domains or continue into packaging automatically.
